Recent notes

  • MX17 X asymmetry: the contingency plan 2026-10-23Cosmic benchMicromegasDetector model

    The X neighbour asymmetry stays unexplained (closed 2026-10-23): freeze the symmetric r06 kernel, carry the det2/det3 position correction as a systematic, and write the asymmetry up as a measured detector property. It shifts X positions by up to ~0.1 mm and leaves the resolution unchanged; a toy puts its angle cost at −0.05° overall and ±0.19° head-on.

  • MX17 papers: the two-paper plan 2026-10-23DetectorPaper

    The detector paper split into two companions (detector & performance; reconstruction with a hits-vs-waveforms comparison): outlines, work left, order of work, n_TOF tripwires.

  • MX17 re-run plan 2026-10-23Cosmic benchMicromegasWaveformsRe-run

    Plan for the one-pass lxplus re-run of the June bench and SPS det4 analysis with the physical RC kernel, and the pre-run checks (decoder, v calibration, common mode, solver guard) that shaped it.

  • det3 X neighbour asymmetry: an audit 2026-10-23DetectorCrosstalk

    CLOSED 2026-10-23, cause not identified. Fresh-eyes summary of the study. Every June board carries a smooth, two-signed, X-only field that moves charge from neighbour n−1 to n+1, sized by the cloud width alone. Electronics, copies, linear coupling, Y→X transfer, charging and gap conduction are excluded. 2026-10-22: the print film of the resistive strips measures 761 µm (not 780): if it is the production print, strip registration cannot make the field and the sim overstates the strips. 2026-10-23: no pillar lattice in the data either, and tracks cannot scan a pad. Fingerprint, exclusions, what is left.

  • Target options for MX17 at LNL 2026-10-22LnlTarget

    Film, backing, cooling, vacuum and monitoring for the ⁷Li(p,e⁺e⁻)⁸Be target: 20 µm Li gives ×8 the rate per proton; diamond backings stay cold far beyond LNL currents; backing γ-rays never reach the signal window; Geant4 L9 of the assembly; and the hydrogen/adhesion/vacuum gaps still to test.

  • The lithium target: what stopped LNL, and what could stop MX17 2026-10-22LnlTarget

    Why the LNL 2023–24 ⁸Be run may have stalled (LiF at 1.03 MeV: ¹⁹F makes 2480–3540 pairs per ⁸Be pair; hot strip targets), and a full study of a thin lithium target for MX17 at LNL: fluorine, heat, diffusion, boron, carbon, hydrogen, and what each does to the 3D fit.
